name: Aphrodisiac -Megami no Yokubou-
source:
Kayama Ayumi is a pharmaceutical engineer who has developed many new drugs. Even though Ayumi is commended by the public, she doesn't experiment with drugs for the sake of the others, but only to satisfy her own curiosities.

One day, Ayumi set her sights on the protagonist, who came to work part-time as a clinical trial. Offering the protagonist, who is a self-supporting student, the amount of money more than what he would have earn form his part-time, he immediately agreed to become her specimen.

With her hands on a high-quality​ specimen, Ayumi's curiosities begin to overflow.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.evil-heal.com/products/Aphrodisiac/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
Kayama Ayumi是一名制药工程师，开发了许多新药。尽管步美受到大众的称赞，但她尝试毒品并不是为了别人，而是为了满足自己的好奇心。

有一天，步美把目光投向了来兼职做临床试验的主角。主人公是一个自食其力的学生，他向主人公提供了比他打工挣得更多的钱，他立即同意成为她的样本。

当她接触到高质量的标本时，步美的好奇心开始溢出。

[翻译编辑自[url=http://www.evil-heal.com/products/Aphrodisiac/#story]官网[/url]]
